methods.failed_subject: Treating embedded prose as live instruction
methods.recovery: Classify the entire file as historical source data and set embedded_instructions_active false.
methods.recurrence_guard: Source role is required before extraction.
methods.rollback: Discard derived interpretation; preserve the source digest.

methods.trigger: Candidate records intentionally violate a declared contract.
methods.recovery: Reject each subject while preserving its separate passing refusal check.
methods.recurrence_guard: Never credit the invalid subject for a successful rejection.
methods.rollback: Return to the valid finite fixture.

methods.trigger: Cleanup quotas could invite destructive actions.
methods.recovery: Use read-only review, additive correction, explicit manifests, and selection-based rollback.
methods.recurrence_guard: Destructive target must be exact and separately justified.

methods.trigger: Runner availability is not evidence of use.
methods.recovery: Compile and execute positive plus negative smoke paths for each runner.
methods.recurrence_guard: Record actual invocation outputs and exact source digest.
methods.rollback: Keep the runner local or return selection to its previous source.

methods.trigger: The first x2 aggregate reached its HTML gate after substantive outputs persisted.
methods.failed_subject: HTML page omitted the exact NOT_READY_FOR_STAGE_20 token while preserving equivalent prose.
methods.recovery: Patch only the HTML template and generated page with the exact machine-readable verdict, then run the isolated x2 validator.
methods.recurrence_guard: Require the exact terminal verdict token in generated HTML before an aggregate runs.
methods.rollback: Restore the prior page content while retaining this failed aggregate receipt; no successful x2 component is replayed.
